This table gives the location within this Code of those ordinances adopted since the
1962 Code, which are included herein. Ordinances adopted prior to such date were incorporated
into the 1962 Code, as supplemented. Ordinances adopted since the 1962 Code, and not
listed herein, have been omitted as repealed, superseded or not of a general and permanent
nature.
